name: ryu.zvec-grep
description: Local-first hybrid workspace search through zvec-grep's `zg` MCP bridge. Use semantic and ranked retrieval over an explicitly indexed workspace, with local models by default and source-linked results. Requires Node.js 22+; no Ryu API key.

zvec_grep.description: zvec-grep's pinned stdio bootstrap bridge. It starts or reuses the local zvec-grep daemon and proxies the default indexed-search MCP toolset over stdin/stdout; Node.js 22+ is required.
